Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 714 PM EDT Sat Oct 17 2026

- A Frost Advisory is in effect late tonight for the area generally 
south and east of a line from Howell to Sandusky. This extends to 
the Ohio border outside of metro Detroit. 

- A warming trend begins Sunday and continues along with dry weather 
throughout the week.

&&

.AVIATION...

Deep H5 to H3 ridging will build directly through Lower Michigan 
tonight. Midlevel flow trajectories will remain anticyclonic 
throughout the period with deep subsidence between 3.0 and 15.0 kft 
agl. Expectations are for VFR conditions with minimal signal for fog 
Sunday morning. Southwest gradient is expected to hold on throughout 
the night particularly at KMBS. 

D21/DTW Convection...There will be no thunderstorms through the TAF 
period.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* None.
